items.headline: OpenAI claims Navier-Stokes proof, igniting authorship dispute with rival mathematicians
items.summary: OpenAI says an internal model beyond GPT-6 Astra, using roughly 10,000 concurrent agents over 88 hours, produced a proof that 3D Navier-Stokes equations can blow up in finite time, one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems. The unpublished claim triggered a public clash after NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge accused OpenAI of following their prior Lean-verified Euler blowup work without credit.

items.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra, its first model to hit 'Critical' cybersecurity capability
items.summary: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 Astra with a 1M-token context window, built on its largest training run yet, and president Greg Brockman called it a potential step toward AGI. It's also the first OpenAI model rated Critical under the company's Preparedness Framework for autonomous vulnerability discovery.

items.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and a defenders-only Cyber variant
items.summary: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash release in six weeks, alongside a Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber model restricted to trusted defenders via its Fairwind Program for autonomous vulnerability discovery. The move continues a rapid cadence of frontier releases as Google tries to close the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.headline: Anthropic debuts Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 in a triple-release push
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 broadly while gating the more capable Mythos 5.1 behind trusted-access programs for cybersecurity and life-sciences work. The launch kicked off the densest 72 hours of frontier model activity this year, with OpenAI, Google and Meta all shipping within 48 hours.

items.headline: Google, Anthropic and OpenAI simultaneously unveil dedicated cybersecurity AI models
items.summary: All three labs announced cyber-focused model variants and new safeguards in the same week: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, Anthropic's gated Mythos 5.1 access plus Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, and OpenAI's added misuse protections. The coordinated rollout underscores growing concern that increasingly capable models can automate sophisticated offensive cyber operations as easily as defensive ones.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO timeline slips toward mid-October
items.summary: Anthropic is reportedly pushing its public listing to mid-October, targeting a roughly $2 trillion valuation and up to $100 billion raised, after posting its first operating profit in Q2. The delay comes even as the company races to complete the offering before U.S. midterm elections in November.

items.headline: Mistral AI raises largest-ever European tech funding round at €3 billion
items.summary: Samsung led a €3 billion Series D for the French AI lab at a post-money valuation above €21 billion, with BlackRock, ASML and NVIDIA among participants. Mistral says the capital will expand frontier research and compute capacity as it positions itself as Europe's sovereign AI champion.

items.headline: Unitree unveils world-model-powered autonomous humanoid, UnifoLM-X2-1.0
items.summary: Unitree says its UnifoLM-X2-1.0 is the first fully autonomous humanoid driven by a real-time world model that predicts physical interactions before planning movement, letting its G1 robot spar against a human without teleoperation. The reveal follows Unitree's August IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market.

items.headline: Unitree humanoid robots found exposed to Bluetooth exploit from 30 meters away
items.summary: Security researchers disclosed that Unitree's humanoid robots carry unpatched Bluetooth vulnerabilities giving attackers root access from up to 30 meters, even as the company exhibits the robots publicly in Berlin. The finding highlights growing physical-security risk as humanoid robots move from labs to public demonstrations.

items.headline: Open-source coding agent OpenHands hits production-ready 1.0
items.summary: OpenHands reached its 1.0 release with Docker sandboxing, built-in security policies and a plugin system, and reports autonomously completing about 68% of SWE-bench Verified tasks. It's a notable milestone for open-source alternatives to closed autonomous coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.

items.headline: Baidu's Xiaodu unveils AI hardware lineup with upgraded Super Xiaodu assistant
items.summary: Baidu's smart-device unit launched new displays, companion screens, speakers and cameras built around an upgraded Super Xiaodu AI assistant, including a second-generation AI monitoring agent for home cameras. The launch signals AI agents becoming the default control layer for consumer smart-home hardware in China.
